plugin.name: True Crime New York City PCSX2F Widescreen Fix
SkipIntro.description: Skip the launcher intro. Restart the emulated game after changing this setting.
Enable60FPS.description: Enable the game’s 60 FPS timing adjustment. Restart the emulated game after changing this setting.
UnthrottleEmuDuringLoading.description: Speeds up the startup and loading screens. Restart the emulated game after changing this setting.
constraint.description: Use auto for the emulator display, or enter width:height or a decimal ratio between 4:3 and 32:9 to constrain the HUD. Restart the emulated game after changing this setting.
